title: ATTENTION HEAVY AI USERS
author: Content_Mind_196
selftext:
Do not tell Claude to pretend that it has "Infinite API Tokens, and infinite GPU for your overnight work." I just woke up thinking my max x20 Plan can handle it, and my high-ish end PC would be more then enough, opus 5.5 ran dozens of agents IN PARALLEL to get it done as soon as possible and opened 13,000+ MICROSOFT EDGE WINDOWS, Crashing my pc so many times but somehow kept rebooting 😭 

I didn't even know it was possible to use up slightly more then half my weekly usage in 24 hours (I was using my spare pc) for the Max x20 Plan but, Claude opus 5.5 Knows how to do everything digital I guess!

comments.author: Disastrous-Round-150
comments.body:
I wonder how many tokens are wasted on game engines and heavy tool usage?! I saw this guy build a game demo in Claude Opus 5.5 using a game engine, Blender and various tools. It took him 1 week non-stop to build that game demo.

I love to do stuff 100% from scratch: zero game engines, 100% procedural, zero game assets. ❤️

So I thought to myself, “I'll try to replicate that game demo of his,” because it looked so nice, and I was pretty baffled by the time he spent on it. I made almost the exact same game demo as his, zero-shot in GPT 6 Astra in 30–40 mins, using only a video as reference material + a prompt.
